news.title: Metaplanet to take 93.7% stake in Super League through 2,100 BTC deal
news.text: Metaplanet to take 93.7% stake in Super League through 2,100 BTC deal The transaction would give Metaplanet access to US capital markets, where it plans to use preferred stock offerings to finance additional Bitcoin purchases.

news.title: Strive buys $335M in Bitcoin, boosting holdings to 36,818 BTC
news.text: Strive buys $335M in Bitcoin, boosting holdings to 36,818 BTC The Bitcoin treasury company added another 1,223 BTC after an earlier purchase pushed it past MARA Holdings, while continuing to expand its reserves through equity financing.

news.title: Bitcoin is rejected at $83K as US bond yields reverse higher with equities
news.text: Bitcoin is rejected at $83K as US bond yields reverse higher with equities Bitcoin price action failed to improve with equities as a sell wall at $83,000 kept BTC in a tight range.

news.title: Strategy buys $22M in Bitcoin, repurchases $193M in STRC
news.text: Strategy buys $22M in Bitcoin, repurchases $193M in STRC Strategy added 267 Bitcoin to its holdings as it bought back 1.94 million STRC shares and boosted its preferred stock buyback program to $3 billion.

news.title: World Liberty’s USD1 stablecoin sheds $400M in market cap in two weeks
news.text: World Liberty’s USD1 stablecoin sheds $400M in market cap in two weeks World Liberty Financial’s USD1 stablecoin saw its market cap decrease more than $400 million over two weeks of large redemptions on Ethereum and BNB Chain.

news.title: JPMorgan takes JPM Coin to Ethereum for institutional clients: Report
news.text: JPMorgan takes JPM Coin to Ethereum for institutional clients: Report JPMorgan is reportedly expanding its JPM Coin deposit token to Ethereum, allowing institutional clients to make payments and settle tokenized asset transactions.

news.title: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs shed $549M as October ETH outflows near $1B
news.text: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs shed $549M as October ETH outflows near $1B US spot Ether ETFs recorded around $955 million in October net outflows so far, while Bitcoin funds extended their weekly withdrawal streak to two weeks.

news.title: JPMorgan brings JPM Coin, representing dollar deposits, to Ethereum
news.text: JPMorgan brings JPM Coin, representing dollar deposits, to Ethereum JPMorgan's dollar deposit token is heading to Ethereum as the lender looks to offer it to wider selection of institutional clients.

news.text: Deutsche Bank targets Asia crypto custody expansion in 2027 as German launch nears The service will initially support bitcoin, ether and the stablecoins USDC, EURC and EURAU, with the bank managing clients’ wallets and private keys.
